response.body:
Three weeks with a mechanical keyboard

Posted by Ravi

I switched to a mechanical keyboard three weeks ago after a decade of laptop keyboards, and I have opinions now, apparently.

The first thing I noticed was the sound. My partner noticed it too, immediately, and not in a good way.

By the second week the typos had dropped off noticeably. I think the extra key travel gives my fingers more time to correct course mid-press.

I don't know if I'd recommend the switch to everyone, but for anyone who writes for a living, it might be worth the two weeks of adjustment.
